requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: Built a four-element uniform linear array beamformer as a personal project to get hands-on experience with phased-array principles.

requirements.note: This is described as a personal/side project ('no publication, no employer involvement'), not professional work; no professional beamforming project is named elsewhere.

lines.quote: A significant part of my work involves writing and optimising real-time signal processing code in C and C++ for TI DSP and ARM Cortex-M platforms – carrier acquisition loops, synchronisation engines, real-time spectral monitoring modules.

I have built and maintained several production Python tools that our engineering team relies on daily – automated test execution and reporting, measurement instrument control libraries, and a build verification framework that runs against our firmware every night.

Conduct RF front-end measurements and characterisation for wideband receiver products, including phase noise testing, intermodulation distortion analysis, and gain flatness measurement across 1–18 GHz
Design and implement extended Kalman filter variants for carrier tracking in frequency-hopping communication receivers

requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience
requirements.note: Cover letter expresses wanting to pursue work on spaceborne/airborne instruments but does not claim prior experience on such platforms.

lines.quote: EU/EEA citizen (Hungarian passport), employed on a standard Finnish employment contract
I should note that Polaris RF Labs is an English-speaking workplace.
Our team includes engineers from Finland, Hungary, Germany, India, and the UK, and all technical communication – design reviews, documentation, daily coordination, everything – happens in English.
Willing to relocate to Oulu; have visited the Polaris RF Labs Oulu test facility on multiple occasions and am familiar with the area
